column1: # mapping_set_title: 'CERT-In SBOM & AIBOM Guidelines v2.0 <-> SPDX 3.0.1'

# mapping_set_description: 'Maps the 21 SBOM Data Fields and 19 AIBOM Elements defined in Technical Guidelines on SBOM | QBOM & CBOM | AIBOM | HBOM (Version 2.0) (CERT-In, July 2025) to classes and properties in the SPDX 3.0.1 specification. The bridge_concept column cites the neutral bridge concept from bom.ttl. Derived from the SPDX 3.1-dev mapping (tools/derive_spdx30.py): SPDX 3.1 is backward compatible with 3.0, so every target that exists in 3.0.1 is mapped the same way; targets added in 3.1 (Core/version, Core/intendedUse, isoAutomationLevel, byteSize, finetunedOn / pretrainedOn / validatedOn / evaluatedOn, conformsTo / Specification, SupportRelationship, ContactPointRelationship, InteractionTemplate, the Hardware profile) are replaced by the closest 3.0.1 carrier or recorded as GAP rows.'

column8: comment
Element.name on a Package or Artifact element carries the component name.
Software/Package.packageVersion (0..1) carries the component version string. Exact match. (SPDX 3.1 deprecates it in favour of Core/version on Package.)
Element.description (0..1) carries the component description; Element.summary (0..1) holds a short form. exactMatch.
Artifact.suppliedBy (-> Agent) identifies the supplier of the software component. exactMatch.

Relationship with relationshipType hasDeclaredLicense from the Package to an AnyLicenseInfo element (LicenseExpression, ListedLicense, CustomLicense); hasConcludedLicense for the analyst-concluded licence. SPDX 3.x has no Package.concludedLicense property.

Artifact.originatedBy identifies the originating Agent; Organization.headquartersLocation -> PhysicalLocation.country (3.1-dev) carries the country of origin. closeMatch: open-source vs proprietary classification is carried by the license, not a dedicated field.
Core/Relationship is the generic typed-relationship container. closeMatch.

A Relationship with relationshipType dependsOn: from = the component, to = the components or libraries it depends on (named with their versions as Package elements). exactMatch. The model requires a LifecycleScopedRelationship for this type (scope: LifecycleScopeType).
Security.Vulnerability elements and VulnAssessmentRelationship subclasses (VexAffected, VexFixed, VexNotAffected, VexUnderInvestigation, CVSS/EPSS/SSVC assessments) track component vulnerabilities.

Patch and remediation status is expressed via the VEX VulnAssessmentRelationship subclasses (VexFixed / VexAffected / VexNotAffected / VexUnderInvestigation); patchedBy / fixedIn relationship types link the fixing release.
Artifact.releaseTime specifies the official release date and time.

Artifact.validUntilTime (0..1) records until when the artifact can be used before reassessment; Artifact.supportLevel (SupportType endOfSupport / noSupport) states the support status and ExternalRef eolNotice links the EOL announcement. SPDX 3.0.1 has no end-of-support date property (3.1-dev adds SupportRelationship.endTime). closeMatch.
GAP (missing field): no criticality level property in SPDX 3.0.1 or 3.1-dev; Element.comment or security assessment notes can carry it. broadMatch (container fallback).
ExternalRef with externalRefType license links the acceptable-use policy or licence terms that carry the restrictions. closeMatch.
Artifact.verifiedUsing (0..*) -> IntegrityMethod; a Core/Hash object holds the algorithm/hashValue pair, mapped separately below. closeMatch at property level.
Hash.hashValue (1..1, hexadecimal string) is the digest. narrowMatch (one aspect of the algorithm + digest pair).
Hash.algorithm (1..1, HashAlgorithm vocabulary: sha256, sha512, sha3_256, blake2b512, blake3, md5, ...). narrowMatch (one aspect of the algorithm + digest pair).
Element.comment carries free-text comments or notes.
CreationInfo.createdBy captures the agent(s) that authored the document.
CreationInfo.created is a mandatory Core/DateTime (UTC, second resolution) recording when the SBOM was created.

SoftwareArtifact.primaryPurpose = executable (SoftwarePurpose). closeMatch: a purpose is not the structural flag (a shared library is executable but has purpose library); see GAP-12 for the proposed isExecutable.

SoftwareArtifact.primaryPurpose = archive (SoftwarePurpose). closeMatch: a purpose is not the structural flag (a container image is an archive but has purpose container); see GAP-12 for the proposed isArchive.
primaryPurpose = container for a container image that bundles sub-components. closeMatch.

GAP (missing field): no structured-archive flag. primaryPurpose = archive is a structured archive whose internal component metadata is recoverable, as opposed to firmware or executable blobs. closeMatch.
GAP (missing field): primaryPurpose = container (image) is likewise a structured archive. closeMatch.
additionalPurpose = archive when the structured-archive nature is secondary. closeMatch.
additionalPurpose = container when the structured-archive nature is secondary. closeMatch.
Software.Package.packageUrl carries the PURL unique identifier.
Element.name on an AI.AIPackage element carries the AI model name.
Software/Package.packageVersion (0..1, inherited by AIPackage) carries the model version string. Exact match. (SPDX 3.1 deprecates it in favour of Core/version on Package.)

AI/AIPackage.typeOfModel (0..*, free text) records the model type; its definition cites learning paradigms (supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement) and it also carries the architecture in practice. closeMatch.
Artifact.originatedBy specifies the developer or organization that authored the model.
Relationship with relationshipType hasDeclaredLicense from the AIPackage to an AnyLicenseInfo element carries the model licensing terms (CustomLicense for RAIL-style or proprietary terms).
A LifecycleScopedRelationship with relationshipType dependsOn and scope runtime / build from the AIPackage to the Software/Package elements of the frameworks and libraries. closeMatch.

Software/Package elements (name, version, packageUrl) for the frameworks, runtimes and libraries the model depends on. closeMatch: Package is the class of every software package; the dependsOn relationship identifies the infrastructure items.

AI/AIPackage.hyperparameter (DictionaryEntry) and typeOfModel capture the algorithm settings and model type; the model artefacts themselves are File / Package elements (bom:ai-model-parameters). closeMatch.

AIPackage.typeOfModel (0..*, string) names the model class and architecture (e.g. transformer, decision tree); learning mechanism has no dedicated field (GAP) and goes into the same free text. closeMatch.
AI/AIPackage.metric (0..*, DictionaryEntry) and metricDecisionThreshold carry model evaluation metrics; energyConsumption covers energy KPIs. closeMatch.

Dataset.DatasetPackage.dataCollectionProcess describes how and from where the data was gathered; Artifact.originatedBy / suppliedBy identify the source organisation. closeMatch (the how-aspect of the source).
Artifact.originatedBy on the DatasetPackage names the Agent(s) that created or contributed the dataset (the who-aspect of the source). closeMatch.

Relationship from the AIPackage to each DatasetPackage with relationshipType trainedOn or testedOn (SPDX 3.0.1 has only these two; the stage goes in Relationship.comment); the DatasetPackage carries name, version and format. exactMatch.

GAP (missing profile): SPDX 3.0.1 has no Hardware profile and no runsOn relationship (both are 3.1 additions). Accelerators and hosts can only be described as free text (Element.comment, AIPackage.informationAboutTraining for training hardware) or modelled as generic Package elements linked by dependsOn. broadMatch (container fallback).

GAP (missing field): no security-controls field. Element.externalRef (ExternalRefType securityThreatModel, secureSoftwareAttestation, other) can link the controls documentation. broadMatch (container).

GAP (missing field): no structured input modality field in SPDX 3.0.1 or 3.1-dev. informationAboutApplication (free text) can state the input types; typeOfModel may hint at them. broadMatch (container fallback).

GAP (missing field): no structured output modality field in SPDX 3.0.1 or 3.1-dev. informationAboutApplication (free text) can state the output types; typeOfModel may hint at them. broadMatch (container fallback).

SPDX 3.0.1 has no intended-use field on AIPackage (Core/intendedUse on Artifact is a 3.1 addition; Dataset/intendedUse exists for datasets only). AI/AIPackage.informationAboutApplication (0..1, free text: how the model is used, its intended application and pre-processing) is the closest carrier of the provider-declared intended use. closeMatch.
AI/AIPackage.domain (0..*, string) names the domain in which the model can be expected to operate; the sector half of an intended-use statement. relatedMatch.
AIPackage.limitation (0..1, string) states the contexts in which the model should not be used. closeMatch (limitation also covers technical limitations).

AIPackage.energyConsumption carries training, fine-tuning and inference energy (energyQuantity + energyUnit). GAP (missing field): the CERT-In element also asks for carbon footprint and resource use, which have no field. closeMatch (energy only).
Security.Vulnerability elements track known security issues in the AI model and dependencies.

GAP (missing field): no native author-signature property. Element.verifiedUsing + Hash proves integrity only, one aspect of an attestation; signatures are attached externally (in-toto / DSSE envelope). narrowMatch.
